subject.event: The domain example.com is removed from Google's search index within 90 days
subject.outcomeDefinition: A site: query for example.com on Google returns zero results on 2026-09-18, checked from three geographies.
subject.resolutionSource: Google Search, queried directly. Wholly external to DeadInternetDetector.

falsifiability.basis: The index status is checked after this record is written, and nothing in this analysis affects whether the page is indexed.

baseline.source: Base rate of 90-day deindexing among analyzed domains
baseline.basis: Proportion of 1,902 analyzed domains observed deindexed within 90 days of first analysis.

sampleSize.basis: Domains first analyzed 2025-01 to 2026-03 with an index check at day 90.

knownGaps: Manual Google penalties are not observable; only the outcome is.

regime.description: Google shipped a spam-policy update in 2026-05 that changed deindexing rates.
regime.accountedFor: Sample restricted to post-update follow-ups where available (412 of 1902) and the interval widened to span the pre- and post-update base rates.

market.reason: Nothing prices the deindexing of a specific domain.
